source_title: Concurrent Technologies plc Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: The issuer's reports archive identifies the May 2020 2019 Annual Report and Accounts; the official PDF is page-inspectable through the public web archive, while direct byte retrieval was blocked by DNS resolution in the controlled environment.
observation: COVID-19 created possible customer delays and management had begun precautionary expense reduction and tighter receivables management. These were contingency measures rather than a disclosed restructuring. Revenue reached a record £19.38m, gross margin improved 50bps to 52.7%, EBITDA rose to £5.07m, cash increased to £10.49m, the Group had no borrowings, and management considered the need for debt or equity very remote.
already_announced_exclusion: No restructuring target event was disclosed; precautionary COVID-19 expense controls are treated as already implemented contingency measures rather than a future event.
review_note: Limited pandemic contingency pressure was outweighed by record revenue, stable-to-improving margin, higher EBITDA, rising cash and a debt-free balance sheet.

source_title: Concurrent Technologies plc Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: The issuer's reports archive identifies the May 2022 2021 Annual Report and Accounts and the issuer publication notice is dated 30 May 2022; the official PDF remained web-indexed, while direct byte retrieval was blocked by DNS resolution in the controlled environment.
observation: Restricted component supply and uncertainty over shipment timing created operational pressure, but management explicitly rejected damaging cost-cutting and continued investing for growth. Revenue slipped 3%, while gross margin improved 220bps to 55.9%, EBITDA and profit before tax increased, cash held at £11.8m, and the order book reached a record level.
already_announced_exclusion: Management explicitly said it would not damage the business through cost-cutting; no restructuring target event was disclosed.
review_note: Supply-chain and shipment-timing pressure was contained by improved margin and profit, steady cash, a record order book and an explicit decision to continue growth investment rather than cut costs.

source_title: Concurrent Technologies plc Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: The issuer's 14 May 2024 publication notice states that the 2023 Annual Report and Accounts was posted and made available on its website; the official PDF is page-inspectable through the public web archive, while direct byte retrieval was blocked by DNS resolution in the controlled environment.
observation: The Group described organisational changes for operational efficiency and residual effects from component shortages, including a first-half £1.5m cash outflow. Those organisational changes were already implemented and are excluded. Revenue rose 73% to a record £31.7m, EBITDA more than doubled to £6m, gross margin stabilised and slightly improved, year-end cash reached £11.12m after an equity raise and acquisition funding, and eight major design wins supported long-term revenue visibility.
already_announced_exclusion: The organisational and culture changes described as implemented during FY23, plus the completed Phillips Aerospace acquisition, are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Already-implemented organisational changes and easing component constraints supplied limited residual pressure; record revenue and profitability, improved gross margin, restored cash generation and substantial design wins supplied decisive contrary evidence.
